description: This is a Java test source file for integration testing within the Apache Fineract project. It contains tests for different instance modes enabled via custom annotations, verifying access restrictions and behaviors based on read-only, write-only, or batch modes. The file uses JUnit 5 for testing and includes setup of REST-assured specifications for API testing.

classes.name: InstanceModeIntegrationTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing different instance modes (read-only, write-only, batch) in the Apache Fineract project using custom annotations to configure environment and verifying API behaviors accordingly.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST-assured specifications and retrieves scheduler job ID before each test.

methods.name: testGetHeadOfficeWorks_WhenInstanceModeIsReadOnly
methods.description: Tests that the getHeadOffice API call succeeds when the instance mode is set to read-only.

methods.name: testGetHeadOfficeWorks_WhenInstanceModeIsWriteOnly
methods.description: Tests that the getHeadOffice API call succeeds when the instance mode is set to write-only.

methods.name: testGetHeadOfficeDoesntWork_WhenInstanceModeIsBatchOnly
methods.description: Verifies that getHeadOffice API call fails (responds with 405) when the instance mode is batch only.

methods.name: testCreateClientDoesntWork_WhenReadOnly
methods.description: Ensures that creating a client is not permitted (responds with 405) in read-only mode.

methods.name: testCreateClientWorks_WhenWriteOnly
methods.description: Checks that creating a client is successful in write-only mode.

methods.name: testCreateClientDoesntWork_WhenBatchOnly
methods.description: Verifies that creating a client is not permitted (responds with 405) in batch-only mode.

methods.name: testRunSchedulerJobDoesntWork_WhenReadOnly
methods.description: Tests that scheduling a job is not allowed when in read-only mode.

methods.name: testRunSchedulerJobDoesntWork_WhenWriteOnly
methods.description: Tests that scheduling a job is not allowed when in write-only mode.

methods.name: testRunSchedulerJobWorks_WhenBatchOnly
methods.description: Ensures that running scheduler jobs works normally in batch-only mode.
